title: Hearty Mediterranean Chicken Tagine
description: A one-pot Mediterranean dish featuring chicken, pine nuts, and a blend of aromatic spices, resulting in a jammy and shattering texture.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the brine-wet chicken thighs and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the pine nuts, dried apricots, chicken broth, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
